name: eve-assistant
description: E.V.E — assistente pessoal de desktop com voz feminina, esfera holográfica, pesquisa na web por vários buscadores, leitura de PDF com OCR, skills e acesso ao Mac

scripts.native: swiftc -O native/ev-listen.swift -o native/ev-listen -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/helper-info.plist && swiftc -O native/ev-pdf.swift -o native/ev-pdf && swiftc -O native/ev-cal.swift -o native/ev-cal -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/cal-info.plist && swiftc -O native/ev-pdf-criar.swift -o native/ev-pdf-criar
scripts.install-app: bash build/pack.sh && rm -rf ~/Applications/'E.V.E.app' ~/Applications/'E.V.app' && cp -R dist/E.V.E-darwin-*/E.V.E.app ~/Applications/ && echo '✓ instalado em ~/Applications/E.V.E.app'
